Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: They listed an incorrect set of stations for the Franklin-Foxboro line by including Providence/Stoughton line stops (Route 128, Canton Junction, Canton Center, Sharon, Mansfield) and misordering/omitting actual Franklin line stops (e.g., Islington, Norwood Depot, Norwood Central). This faulty list led to an inflated count of 12 instead of the correct 10, and the subsequent acceptance of this count was based on that erroneous listing.
